name: Low Shield - See Past Your Shield
summary: Shrinks and lowers the first-person shield so it stops covering your screen in fights.
body:
**Low Shield - See Past Your Shield** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- The held shield renders about 45% smaller in first person
- It also sits lower, below your crosshair instead of across the middle of the screen
- Blocking still works exactly like vanilla - only the visuals change

### Why players use it
- You keep your target, the mob in front of you and your surroundings visible while blocking
- Useful in PvP, in raids and against any mob that makes you hold right-click

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---

### Get the whole set
This is part of the **PvP Essentials** family - the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)
